doc: Exercise -> muscles, and the green/yellow/red rule. Used by the worker (to write sets.* and muscle_scores) and the web (labels, legend). Exercise keys are Brodie plan names.
Step 1, per set. done = reps Brodie counted, planned = the target, faulty = reps with at least one fault label.
fault_rate = faulty / done (0 if done is 0)
dropoff    = max(0, fault rate of the later half of the reps - fault rate of the earlier half). Halves split at floor(done / 2); 0 if done < 4.
quality    = clamp(1 - w.fault_rate * fault_rate - w.missed * (1 - completion) - w.dropoff * dropoff, 0, 1)
Step 2, per muscle. score = weighted mean of quality over every set that worked it (primary weight 1.0, secondary 0.5).
Step 3, color. score >= green_min -> green, >= yellow_min -> yellow, else red. A muscle no set worked gets no row: draw it grey.
session.overall_score = plain mean of the set qualities.
